overview.text: The Tiger Rat Snake, or Chicken Snake, is a big, non-venomous snake of the American tropics, from southern Mexico to Argentina. It is bold black and yellow.

identification.text: Black with yellow spots that may form bands; a yellow snout tip; yellow belly with black bands.

size.label: Adults
size.text: Usually 1.5 to 2 m long, up to about 2.7 m.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Southern Mexico, Central America, Trinidad and Tobago, and much of South America to northern Argentina.

behaviour.text: Active by day, hunting actively both in trees and on the ground.

diet.text: A wide range of prey: rodents, bats, birds and their eggs, lizards and amphibians.

recognise.text: Black and yellow, with a yellow snout tip.
